description: Evaluation inspector over a SAVED evaluation document: summary — the origin card, resultHash and snapshot verification, listings of results, positions and issues; slice — the closure of proof nodes for a query, rule, position or node with addresses, both sides of BOTH, defeats, values, names resolved against the snapshot; diff — what changed between two documents on the context, result and justification levels; locate — the declaration by StableId. Nothing is evaluated or recomputed: the source is evaluation from law_ask(proof=true) or an answerResource. Missing data is a limit state (limits), never a negation.
name: law_inspect
